citations.assessment: London Yuhasin gives Rava and a bracketed Rabbah reading and explicitly says that Mar bar Rav Ashi bought the scarf from his mother. Rashi identifies Kovi as a place-name.

citations.assessment: Heilprin says “from him.” In Kiddushin the seller is explicitly the mother of Rava of Kovi, and Rashi identifies Kovi as a place-name. The price and value are correctly distinguished.

notes.text: Kiddushin names the mother of Rava of Kovi as seller. The same detail occurs in Yuhasin and Rashi explains Kovi as a place-name.
